observations: Predicted €14 for a €10 fixed-charge bill reduced from 40 to 20 kWh, given €18 initial bill.
Tests at 40 showed A €18 and no-fee B €12. Minimum 10 showed €12/€3; one slider step to 20 showed €14/€6.
Screenshot showed positive-intercept and origin lines on common €42 scale. Reveal explicitly answered original halving question, distinguished current state, and stated tariff equality at 100 kWh.

caveat: Tariffs are fictional and actual bills may contain additional terms.
